hypothesis: BYQMZ, FKQLZ and XFEDT of 1941-09-30 are Enigma I traffic (UKW-B, wheels I-V, ten stecker pairs) under one daily key, and BYQMZ's key is one the three completed sweeps (v2 and v3, middle-past-notch; v4, middle-complete) could all miss, most plausibly because BYQMZ carries one dropped or inserted letter. A complete sweep of the middle-complete space (246,767,040 settings) with the split-point climb, which searches the position and kind of one such fault inside every evaluation, then retains at least one candidate that the companion-body confirmation accepts: FKQLZ and XFEDT each deciphered at all 17,576 starts under the candidate's wheel order, rings and plugboard, both best starts at z >= 6.
refuted_by: No retained candidate companion-confirmed. Stated power, fixed by the preregistered rule of phase1-split-point-power-v2 (T1 held, 2026-10-09): among planted draws all three reference climbs miss (the climbs of v2, v3 and v4), the split_complete climb detects 69 of 111 one-indel (62.2%) and 8 of 20 clean (40%); detected and companion-confirmed, measured on the same draws with scripts/joint_power.py (artifacts/phase1-joint-power-v4-split-complete.json, post hoc as for v3 and v4): 68 of 111 (61.3%) and 8 of 20 (40%). The conditional rate given a standard reading and v2, v3 and v4 null is 0.529 detected and 0.524 detected and confirmed at a prior q = 0.2 of one dropped or inserted letter (confirmed: 0.448 at q = 0.05, 0.481 at 0.1, 0.559 at 0.35, 0.580 at 0.5). So a null multiplies the remaining odds of a standard reading by about 0.48 at q = 0.2, taking the four nulls together to about 0.055 (0.035 ungarbled, from a 20-draw stratum, and 0.13 with one indel). Nothing here tests two faults, a substituted letter, other reflectors, other wheel wirings, Naval wheels, other indicator procedures or non-Enigma systems.

scorer_parity.note: The scorers sum the same n-gram terms in different orders, so they agree to floating-point association rather than bit for bit.

evaluated.rationale: The five independently solved 1941 Army plaintexts Phase 7 already uses, each kept as its own message with its own indicator and enciphered by enigma.EnigmaI under one shared ten-pair daily key. That is the real Army situation: several short messages under one key. An earlier version of this control concatenated the five into two messages at the target lengths and failed, because the junctions between unrelated messages are n-grams no Army text contains; the concatenated form was not a legitimate control and was replaced rather than reinterpreted.

execution.note: seconds covers only the chunks run in this invocation; a resumed sweep reports the time of the remainder, and the projections below use the settings run in this invocation.

companion_confirmation.method: Each companion is deciphered at all 17,576 start positions under the candidate's wheel order, reported rings and plugboard, without the indicator. A candidate is confirmed when every companion's best start is at least threshold_z standard deviations above that companion's own start distribution.

indicator_confirmation.ring_recovery: The sweep absorbs the left and middle ring settings into the start position it searches, so the held AAA is the parameterization and not a claim about the daily key. The clear Grundstellung the indicator uses does not share that freedom, so for each candidate every left and middle ring setting that reproduces the swept body through the indicator is scored and the best is reported. The right-hand ring is kept as the sweep used it, because it moves the turnover inside the message and is an axis of the declared space.
indicator_confirmation.method: For each retained candidate the recovered plugboard and a recovered ring setting are used with the clear indicator to derive all three message keys, and the whole date is scored. The sweep itself never reads the indicator, so this is an independent check.

coverage.reducible_space_definition: Every wheel order x 26^4: the left and middle wheel offsets, the right wheel's offset and the right wheel's absolute position (its ring), which fixes when the middle wheel steps. The middle wheel's absolute position fixes when the left wheel steps, so the rule that chooses the middle ring decides which true keys have an exact equivalent in the space; under middle_complete every middle start from which the middle notch falls inside the message is searched too, which multiplies the space.
coverage.exact_key_coverage_meaning: Fraction of true daily keys for which some setting in the reducible space deciphers this message exactly as the true key does, by enumeration of the stepping patterns at this length. A key outside it can still be found if a partly equivalent neighbour survives the climb, which only some of the time it does; the end-to-end power calibration measures how often.

limitations: The controls are constructed or independently solved plaintexts, not authentic held-out Army traffic with an authentic daily key.

The messages behind the published 1941 n-gram counts are not enumerated, so overlap between the authentic control plaintexts and the scorer's training data cannot be ruled out. The constructed control exists to bound that risk, not to remove it.

The positive controls are body-direct and are handed the true wheel order, ring setting and start positions. They certify the stecker stage at the target lengths and say nothing about the rotor enumeration, which the sweeps and calibrations cover separately.

Every result assumes UKW-B, the Army/Air Force wheels I-V and the 1940+ clear-Grundstellung indicator procedure. A different reflector, a Naval wheel or a different indicator convention is outside every space searched here.
The calibrations use one plaintext per cell and a single key draw per cell. They locate the detection boundary to within a cell, not to a precise length.

The authentic control pools five short messages under one daily key (275 letters); the constructed control pools three at the target lengths (371 letters). Neither certifies a single 167-letter message on its own, which is what the capability calibration measures.

The middle-complete space has an exact equivalent for every daily key at 167 letters (rule_key_coverage 1.0). A key is still found only if the climb converges at one of its equivalents and scores into the top 100 of nine times as many settings as v3 searched; the stated power measures the first on planted draws and stands in for the second with a pooled null.

The companion calibration (phase1-companion-calibration-v1) was measured with middle-past-notch candidates. Under middle_complete a candidate's middle ring can put the notch inside a companion, and the companion check presents the candidate's rings as reported, so a companion whose true left wheel steps at a different letter is deciphered exactly only up to that letter. The joint figure in refuted_by includes that case at its natural rate on planted draws.
No result here is an accepted break: a confirmed candidate's plaintext still has to be read and reviewed before accepted_break could change.

The prior q of one dropped or inserted letter is unmeasured. q = 0.2 is the value phase1-middle-complete-power-v1 declared; the stated power at other q is given in refuted_by so another belief can be applied without a rerun.

The cited paper (Sullivan and Weierud 2005, footnote 42) places Batch C on a different radio network and its authors suspect differently wired wheels. Every figure here assumes wheels I-V as wired; if that is wrong the power is zero and a null says nothing about these messages.

The stated power is measured on planted single-indel and clean 167-letter draws through the complete rule's parameterization in the planted key's neighbourhood (phase1-split-point-power-v2, fresh seed 20261109), judged by a 6-sigma threshold over the split climb's own pooled wrong-setting null. The real sweep compares a candidate with the scores of 246.8 million settings; the far tail of that null is not measured, as for v2 to v4.

The power is conditional on v2, v3 and v4 all null, with 'missed by all three reference climbs' on planted draws standing in for the three sweeps being null: one plaintext, a single fault only, 400 draws per cell, and strata of 111 one-indel and 20 clean draws. The clean stratum is too small to state a rate tightly (8 of 20, 95% interval 22-61%).

The split-point climb models one dropped or inserted letter. Two faults, a substituted letter or a transposition are not searched, and a fault within about ten letters of either end is placed there by chance on wrong-setting text, which the mask credit corrects only on average.

The mask credit of -8.66 per dropped n-gram term was measured on wrong-setting text of the earlier controls and applies to BYQMZ's own masked letter (position 28) only approximately; the planted draws carry no masks.

A candidate is reported at the setting that deciphers the letters before the fault. Its hypothesis (kind and position) is reported beside it; the companion check uses only the candidate's wheel order, rings and plugboard, so it does not depend on the hypothesis.

The sweep's scores are the best hypothesis' n-gram score per letter with mask credits, not on the scale of v2's whole-message or v3's and v4's windowed scores; the indicator confirmation compares a pooled date score with this score and is reported but not used. The companion check alone decides.

About 1 in 9.4 settings exactly duplicates another (v4's finding). Duplicates are climbed to identical results and weigh slightly more in the score distribution; they can occupy retention slots, as 12 of v4's 100 did.
